note: Metadata for every version file in this repository. Structural fields (locale, books, verses, testament) are computed from the files by tools/build_versions_manifest.py; editorial fields (year, base_text, philosophy, tradition) are curated. A null means genuinely unknown, not zero.

philosophy: source - a source-language edition, not a translation
optimal - mediating between formal and dynamic

de/GERMAN: LUTHER (1912).name: GERMAN: LUTHER (1912)
de/GERMAN: LUTHER (1912).note: Revision of Luther's 1534 Bible, the founding text of modern German.

el/GREEK ORTHODOX CHURCH 1904.name: GREEK ORTHODOX CHURCH 1904
el/GREEK ORTHODOX CHURCH 1904.note: The Patriarchal Text, official for the Greek Orthodox Church.

el/RP BYZANTINE MAJORITY TEXT 2005.name: RP BYZANTINE MAJORITY TEXT 2005
el/RP BYZANTINE MAJORITY TEXT 2005.note: Robinson-Pierpont. Omits the Comma Johanneum, unlike the TR - which makes the Comma's late entry visible inside the Greek alone.

el/SCRIVENER'S TEXTUS RECEPTUS 1894.name: SCRIVENER'S TEXTUS RECEPTUS 1894
el/SCRIVENER'S TEXTUS RECEPTUS 1894.note: Reconstructs the Greek behind the KJV. Contains the Comma Johanneum.

el/STEPHANUS TEXTUS RECEPTUS 1550.name: STEPHANUS TEXTUS RECEPTUS 1550
el/STEPHANUS TEXTUS RECEPTUS 1550.note: Stephanus' fourth edition; introduced modern verse numbering.

el/SWETE'S SEPTUAGINT.name: SWETE'S SEPTUAGINT
el/SWETE'S SEPTUAGINT.note: Greek Old Testament, c. 3rd-2nd c. BCE; Swete's edition 1887-94. The translation Matthew and Paul quote.

el/TISCHENDORF 8TH EDITION.name: TISCHENDORF 8TH EDITION
el/TISCHENDORF 8TH EDITION.note: Tischendorf discovered Codex Sinaiticus; his edition leans on it heavily.

el/WESTCOTT AND HORT 1881.name: WESTCOTT AND HORT 1881
el/WESTCOTT AND HORT 1881.note: The edition that displaced the Textus Receptus in scholarship.

en/AMERICAN STANDARD VERSION.name: AMERICAN STANDARD VERSION
en/AMERICAN STANDARD VERSION.note: American counterpart of the ERV. Transliterates Sheol and Hades separately instead of both as 'hell'.

en/AMPLIFIED BIBLE.name: AMPLIFIED BIBLE
en/AMPLIFIED BIBLE.note: Expands words with bracketed alternatives rather than choosing.

en/ARAMAIC BIBLE IN PLAIN ENGLISH.name: ARAMAIC BIBLE IN PLAIN ENGLISH
en/ARAMAIC BIBLE IN PLAIN ENGLISH.note: Shows the Petros/petra wordplay that Greek-derived versions lose.

en/BIBLE IN BASIC ENGLISH.name: BIBLE IN BASIC ENGLISH
en/BIBLE IN BASIC ENGLISH.note: Restricted to a controlled ~1,000-word vocabulary, which forces interpretive choices into the open.

en/BRENTON SEPTUAGINT TRANSLATION.name: BRENTON SEPTUAGINT TRANSLATION
en/BRENTON SEPTUAGINT TRANSLATION.note: English of the Greek Old Testament, so it shows what the Septuagint says rather than the Hebrew.

en/DARBY BIBLE 1890.name: DARBY BIBLE 1890
en/DARBY BIBLE 1890.note: John Nelson Darby's translation. Darby also originated the pre-tribulational rapture scheme; his rendering of 1 Thessalonians 4:17 is worth reading against that.

en/DOUAY-RHEIMS BIBLE.name: DOUAY-RHEIMS BIBLE
en/DOUAY-RHEIMS BIBLE.note: Challoner revision. Translated from the Vulgate, so it carries the Latin readings into English.

en/ENGLISH REVISED VERSION.name: ENGLISH REVISED VERSION
en/ENGLISH REVISED VERSION.note: First major revision of the KJV; the first English Bible to drop the Comma Johanneum. Its attributive reading of 2 Timothy 3:16 caused an outcry.

en/ENGLISH STANDARD VERSION.name: ENGLISH STANDARD VERSION
en/ENGLISH STANDARD VERSION.note: An RSV revision in a more conservative direction. Its 2016 change at Malachi 2:16 was contentious.

en/FAMILY 35 NEW TESTAMENT.name: FAMILY 35 NEW TESTAMENT
en/FAMILY 35 NEW TESTAMENT.note: Wilbur Pickering. CC BY-SA 4.0. Follows the Family 35 manuscript line; omits the Comma Johanneum.

en/GENEVA BIBLE 1599.name: GENEVA BIBLE 1599
en/GENEVA BIBLE 1599.note: The Bible of Shakespeare, Bunyan and the Pilgrims. Its readings at Exodus 22:18 ('witch') and Isaiah 14:12 ('Lucifer') predate the KJV.

en/JPS TANAKH 1917.name: JPS TANAKH 1917
en/JPS TANAKH 1917.note: The Jewish Publication Society's Old Testament. Reads 'young woman' at Isaiah 7:14; follows the KJV's 'help meet' at Genesis 2:18.

en/KING JAMES BIBLE.name: KING JAMES BIBLE
en/KING JAMES BIBLE.note: The most influential English Bible; based on the Textus Receptus and heavily dependent on Tyndale.

en/KJV CAMBRIDGE PARAGRAPH BIBLE 1873.name: KJV CAMBRIDGE PARAGRAPH BIBLE 1873
en/KJV CAMBRIDGE PARAGRAPH BIBLE 1873.note: Scrivener's critical edition of the KJV text, correcting printing-history corruptions. Useful as a control on what the KJV actually said.

en/LAMSA BIBLE.name: LAMSA BIBLE
en/LAMSA BIBLE.note: George Lamsa's translation from the Syriac, so it renders from the Aramaic side.

en/LEESER OLD TESTAMENT 1853.name: LEESER OLD TESTAMENT 1853
en/LEESER OLD TESTAMENT 1853.note: The first Jewish translation of the Hebrew Bible into English, 64 years before the JPS. Reads 'this young woman' at Isaiah 7:14.

en/LEGACY STANDARD BIBLE.name: LEGACY STANDARD BIBLE
en/LEGACY STANDARD BIBLE.note: NASB revision rendering the divine name as Yahweh.

en/MACE NEW TESTAMENT.name: MACE NEW TESTAMENT
en/MACE NEW TESTAMENT.note: An early attempt at colloquial English.

en/NASB 1977.name: NASB 1977
en/NASB 1977.note: Descends from the ASV; the NASB line originates partly in reaction to the RSV.

en/NET BIBLE.name: NET BIBLE
en/NET BIBLE.note: Carries tens of thousands of translator notes - none of which are in this corpus, which is why some of its readings look unqualified here.

en/NEW AMERICAN BIBLE.name: NEW AMERICAN BIBLE
en/NEW AMERICAN BIBLE.note: The American Catholic Bible. Reads 'the young woman' at Isaiah 7:14 - the philology is accepted while the doctrine is not at stake.

en/NEW INTERNATIONAL VERSION.name: NEW INTERNATIONAL VERSION
en/NEW INTERNATIONAL VERSION.note: The best-selling modern English Bible. The 2011 edition changed several contested renderings, including 'assume authority' at 1 Timothy 2:12.

en/NEW KING JAMES VERSION.name: NEW KING JAMES VERSION
en/NEW KING JAMES VERSION.note: Modernises the KJV while keeping the Textus Receptus - so it retains the Comma Johanneum but corrects 'Easter'.

en/NEW REVISED STANDARD VERSION.name: NEW REVISED STANDARD VERSION
en/NEW REVISED STANDARD VERSION.note: Successor to the RSV. Restored Junia at Romans 16:7.

en/NOYES TRANSLATION 1869.name: NOYES TRANSLATION 1869
en/NOYES TRANSLATION 1869.note: George Noyes' translation. Reads 'the damsel' at Isaiah 7:14 - 77 years before the RSV was accused of inventing that reading.

en/ROTHERHAM EMPHASISED BIBLE.name: ROTHERHAM EMPHASISED BIBLE
en/ROTHERHAM EMPHASISED BIBLE.note: Rotherham's Emphasised Bible. Transliterates Sheol and Hades rather than flattening both to 'hell', and marks emphasis typographically.

en/SMITH'S LITERAL TRANSLATION.name: SMITH'S LITERAL TRANSLATION
en/SMITH'S LITERAL TRANSLATION.note: Julia E. Smith's translation - the first complete Bible into English by a woman.

en/TARGUM ONKELOS (ETHERIDGE).name: TARGUM ONKELOS (ETHERIDGE)
en/TARGUM ONKELOS (ETHERIDGE).note: Etheridge's English of Targum Onkelos, the authoritative Aramaic paraphrase of the Pentateuch (c. 2nd c. CE). An independent ancient witness to how Jewish readers understood the Hebrew - it renders Genesis 3:15 'He will remember thee'. WARNING: Exodus is offset by one verse (Hebrew numbering) - Targum Exodus 22:17 is the KJV's 22:18. Genesis is aligned.

en/TEXT-CRITICAL ENGLISH NEW TESTAMENT.name: TEXT-CRITICAL ENGLISH NEW TESTAMENT
en/TEXT-CRITICAL ENGLISH NEW TESTAMENT.note: Robert Adam Boyd. CC BY 4.0. Byzantine base with text-critical apparatus.

en/TYNDALE NEW TESTAMENT.name: TYNDALE NEW TESTAMENT
en/TYNDALE NEW TESTAMENT.note: First English NT from the Greek. Much of the KJV's wording is Tyndale's, including 'ester' at Acts 12:4.

en/WEBSTER'S BIBLE TRANSLATION.name: WEBSTER'S BIBLE TRANSLATION
en/WEBSTER'S BIBLE TRANSLATION.note: Noah Webster's light revision of the KJV. Quietly corrects 'Easter' to 'the passover'.

en/WYCLIFFE BIBLE.name: WYCLIFFE BIBLE
en/WYCLIFFE BIBLE.note: Translated from the Vulgate, not the Hebrew or Greek - so it shows which Latin-derived readings reached English before the source texts did. Complete (66 books plus 10 deuterocanonical, including the Epistle to the Laodiceans).

en/YOUNG'S LITERAL TRANSLATION.name: YOUNG'S LITERAL TRANSLATION
en/YOUNG'S LITERAL TRANSLATION.note: Extremely literal, preserving Hebrew and Greek tense and idiom at the cost of English.

es/LA NUEVA BIBLIA DE LOS HISPANOS.name: LA NUEVA BIBLIA DE LOS HISPANOS
es/LA NUEVA BIBLIA DE LOS HISPANOS.path: versions/es/LA NUEVA BIBLIA DE LOS HISPANOS.json

es/TAGALOG: ANG DATING BIBLIA (1905).name: TAGALOG: ANG DATING BIBLIA (1905)
es/TAGALOG: ANG DATING BIBLIA (1905).note: Tagalog, not Spanish - filed under the es/ locale in this repository, which is a data error worth knowing about.

he/ALEPPO CODEX.name: ALEPPO CODEX
he/ALEPPO CODEX.note: The Aleppo Codex; portions lost in 1947.

he/WESTMINSTER LENINGRAD CODEX.name: WESTMINSTER LENINGRAD CODEX
he/WESTMINSTER LENINGRAD CODEX.note: Leningrad Codex B19A, the oldest complete Hebrew Bible. Digital edition re-versified here to English numbering.

he/WLC (CONSONANTS ONLY).name: WLC (CONSONANTS ONLY)
he/WLC (CONSONANTS ONLY).note: Consonantal skeleton of the WLC, without vowel points. Useful for testing vocalization-dependent cases.

la/LATIN: VULGATA CLEMENTINA.name: LATIN: VULGATA CLEMENTINA
la/LATIN: VULGATA CLEMENTINA.note: Clementine edition of Jerome's Vulgate (c. 400). The Bible of Western Christendom for a millennium; the source of 'in quo', 'cornuta', 'Lucifer', 'paenitentiam agite' and 'sacramentum'.

ru/RUSSIAN KOI8R.name: RUSSIAN KOI8R
ru/RUSSIAN KOI8R.note: The Synodal text in KOI8-R encoding.

zh/现代标点和合本 (CUVMP SIMPLIFIED).name: 现代标点和合本 (CUVMP SIMPLIFIED)
zh/现代标点和合本 (CUVMP SIMPLIFIED).note: Chinese Union Version with modern punctuation.

zh/現代標點和合本 (CUVMP TRADITIONAL).name: 現代標點和合本 (CUVMP TRADITIONAL)
zh/現代標點和合本 (CUVMP TRADITIONAL).note: Chinese Union Version with modern punctuation.
